verdict.rationale: A tax-compliance SaaS could plausibly ship its own tax-question AI, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows nothing of the kind. Kintsugi's only AI-facing feature is an MCP server that reads public API docs and the OpenAPI spec to help developers write integration code. It never answers taxability or invoice-explanation questions from a rule base with citations. Product categories and the tax estimate endpoint determine tax, but nothing shows a conversational assistant that explains those outcomes.
